F1 | Unproven | medium | Constituent mechanisms have support, but end-to-end unattended local agent autonomy lacks published validation.
F2 | Disputed | high | Self-correction is contested (Huang et al. 2024 vs Liu et al. 2024); inherited lessons can preserve errors; MAST adds multiagent failure surface.
F3 | Supported | low | RouteLLM establishes learned routing; fleet-level cost-quality economics and distinct concurrency/memory costs remain empirical.
F4 | Disputed | high | Scoped API credentials are not authority containment; Capsicum-style kernel attenuation and AgentDojo adversarial evaluation set the bar; prompt "child <= parent" is not enforcement.
F5 | Disputed | high | HTTP 200 can carry wrong content (SRE golden signals); aggregate failure counts without attempt IDs cannot prove distinct executions.
F6 | Disputed | high | Append-only hash-linked history is not durable-execution semantics (Temporal); caller receipts do not give exactly-once; receiver-side completion/dedup (RIFL), Chubby sequencers, and SQLite transactional ownership are required.
F7 | Disputed | high | Engram is learned n-gram lookup, not shared memory hierarchy; RAGCache/TeleRAG/PerCache are prior art; content-addressed storage (Venti) lacks semantic retrieval/freshness/authz (Zanzibar).
F8 | Supported | low | Arithmetic verified: 19e6*256*2=9,728,000,000 B; +608,000,000+152,000,000=10,488,000,000 B=9.768 GiB; second copy=9.060 GiB; estimate-only budgets do not prove deployment feasibility.
F9 | Disputed | high | Membership inference cannot generally prove training inclusion; retrieval/context extraction does not imply weight memorization; no universal duplicate threshold (Carlini et al.).
F10 | Disputed | high | Arithmetic checks: 512*16=8192, +256=8448 <=10000; false-match <= Q/2^128 ~2.94e-35; but zero hits in 10 trials gives 95% one-sided binomial upper bound ~0.259, not 0.422; ten clean shams do not demonstrate very low contamination.
F11 | Disputed | high | First-pass agreement can reflect decisive evidence, shared flaw, or failed independence (Wynn et al. 2025, Yao et al. 2025); verifiers need hidden ground truth.
F12 | Supported | low | Defensible publication is bounded systems contribution with open failure evidence until independent replication; correctness and performance need different evidential standards.
